status: PRELIMINARY STUDY ASSUMPTIONS; not supplier-approved installation data
battery_bus: two isolated strings with normally open cross-tie; surviving propulsor can access both healthy strings after isolated propulsor failure

accessories.name: motor inverter cooling pumps and fans

battery_cell.facts: 5 Ah typical,18 Wh typical,60 A temperature-limited continuous discharge,5 A standard and25 A maximum charge,71 g maximum cell mass. Cell data only; pack limits below are engineering assumptions.

motor.facts: magni650:700 kW peak,515 kW continuous at2300 rpm,144 kg dry,500-850 VDC. No approved peak duration or hybrid generation/gearbox installation established.

engine.facts: E.070 issue09. Consult applicable0983202 installation and0983302 operation manuals; build-configuration-specific manuals may differ. Five-minute takeoff limit. Custom installation/restart data unresolved.

climb.facts: Study interpretation:Level3 low-speed,4% AEO initial climb,1% after critical loss at400 ft gear retracted takeoff flaps,3% balked landing. Accepted means and complete certification basis unresolved.

classification.facts: 7-9 passenger Level3. Low-speed category additionally depends on VNO/VMO and MMO; assumed for this study, not established by cruise KTAS alone.

feathered_analogue.facts: Research lead for failed-propeller aerodynamics only; the assumed drag area is NOT extracted from this source.

inverter.facts: magniDrive100 public maximum175 kW,550-800 VDC,12.5 kg. Public page does not establish DC-throughput rating, continuous rating or approved parallel/multiwinding topology.

aviation_battery.facts: Samson300 public module13.7 kWh,45.6 kg,300 Wh/kg,819 V maximum,1C discharge. These specific-energy and discharge ratings must remain paired; they are not the5C study pack.

assumptions.mechanical: 0.98 extra shaft efficiency,1500 hp per hybrid gearbox at2080 rpm,0.20 kg/kW additional coupling mass are independent design assumptions. Turbine own gearbox rating is not hybrid combined rating.
assumptions.pack: 3C continuous,5C peak,1C charge,200 Wh/kg,0.85 power and0.90 energy derating are proposed pack-level limits, not demonstrated P50B pack capability. A190S dual-string P50B reference layout operates from551V (2.9V/cell) to798V (4.2V/cell), inside the published magni650 and magniDrive100 voltage windows. Rate power is conservatively multiplied by2.9/3.6 to enforce current-rating power at the proposed minimum voltage. Nominal energy is rounded to complete190S strings with an even parallel-cell count. Usable energy above2.9V, cooling, insulation and pack failure protection remain unverified.
assumptions.schedule: Speeds,rates,takeoff/landing times and60s restart hold are proposed schedules. Restart consumes0.3 kWh stored energy and0.2 lb fuel per turbine; idle20 lb/hr each is an estimate, not GE data. Repeated legs include the full30-minute no-charge turnaround with6 kW auxiliary load; this is the RFP maximum-time energy exposure, not an assumed ground recharge.
assumptions.thermal: Continuous motor/generator ratings approximate adequate cooling. Peak timer includes adjacent peaks and resets only after10 min at<=80% continuous rating. This duty rule is a study assumption, not a thermal model.
assumptions.failure: One isolated propulsor failure removes half motor,inverter,gearbox and turbine output but leaves both battery strings accessible. Additional battery-string-loss case halves battery availability. Common-bus/containment and clutch-jam FMEA remains unresolved. Departure OEI diverts at5000 ft with a250 fpm turbine climb and carries45-minute reserve; it does not attempt the normal10000-ft/700-fpm two-engine schedule or combine a second go-around failure.
assumptions.drag: Feathered drag modeled asq*0.35 ft^2 per failed propeller, independently chosen study estimate. Sensitivity0.15-0.70 ft^2. Not stopped/windmilling drag.
assumptions.accessories: Every equipment kW and duty is a preliminary allowance, not a selected-equipment specification. Battery supplies auxiliaries in electric phases; turbine shaft supplies them during turbine operation, through0.90 shaft-to-DC efficiency.
assumptions.fuel: Existing0.6 lb/hp/hr constant BSFC remains an estimate. Explicit45-min reserve is counted once;1% contingency and1% unusable fuel follow requirements.
assumptions.generation: Bidirectional motor-generator operation is assumed with continuous generating shaft limit equal to motor continuous rating;0.90 stored-energy/extra-turbine-shaft efficiency already includes conversion and charging losses.
assumptions.high_speed: 180 KTAS capability remains mandatory. Full-range 180 KTAS mission is optional and excluded from baseline energy sizing; enable include_high_speed_mission for that separate operating trade.
